name: Enkindle
source:
It's almost spring break! Which means the flowers are blooming, the sun is shining... and it's the day before your crush transfers...?!

A very short visual novel featuring a cute chipmunk boi and nondescript MC.

What will happen the day before he leaves?

[From [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/enkindle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
快要放春假了！这意味着鲜花盛开、阳光明媚……而且是你暗恋对象转会的前一天……？！

一部非常短的视觉小说，以可爱的花栗鼠boi和平淡无奇的MC为主角。

他离开的前一天会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/enkindle]Itch.io[/url]]
